Scale curves: indicator summaries across H3 resolutions

Source: R/scale.R
calc_scale_curves.Rd

For one filter (all taxa, an EOV, an AphiaID subtree or DwC rank values), summarizes the per-cell indicators at each resolution: occupied cells, records, the distribution of records per cell, the fraction of cells where ES(n) is defined (n >= esn), and medians of ES(n) and richness among those. n_cells_all is the number of cells occupied by any taxon at that resolution (from idx_h3), so frac_cells_all reads as the filter's footprint relative to all sampling.

Usage

calc_scale_curves(
  con,
  res = 1:7,
  eov = NULL,
  aphiaid = NULL,
  taxon = NULL,
  years = NULL,
  esn = 50L,
  floors = c(10L, 30L, 100L),
  group = NULL
)

Arguments

con

connection from obis_store_connect().

res

resolutions to evaluate (default 1:7).

eov

optional EOV name (one); see obis_eov_seeds().

aphiaid

optional WoRMS AphiaID(s) — the subtree filter.

taxon

optional named list of DwC rank values; see obis_h3t_sql().

years

optional c(min, max) year range.

esn

expected sample size for ES(n); default 50.

floors

record-count floors for the reliability columns frac_n_ge_<floor> (default 10, 30, 100).

group

optional label carried in a group column (handy when binding curves for several EOVs).

Value

data frame, one row per resolution.
